## Description
Set up an Expo React Native application in the monorepo that will serve as the mobile client for the AI Social Metaverse.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Expo app initialized in `apps/mobile`
- [ ] `App.tsx` with basic navigation structure
- [ ] TypeScript properly configured
- [ ] Basic UI with welcome screen
- [ ] Configured to connect to local backend server
- [ ] React Navigation set up
- [ ] Environment variables configured

## Technical Details
- Use Expo SDK 50.x or latest
- TypeScript enabled
- Add React Navigation for routing
- Configure for both iOS and Android
- Set up axios or fetch for API calls

## Screens
- Splash/Welcome screen
- Login screen placeholder
- Home feed placeholder

- [Expo Documentation](https://docs.expo.dev/)
